title: Plans
description: User, OpenWA session, and message quotas. There is no billing here: this catalog is what the platform uses to cap usage.
search_placeholder: Search by code, name, or badge…

form.description_create: Define a quota plan. The code cannot change later: Orvae and the worker use it as plan_slug.
form.description_edit: Update name, commercial reference, or visibility. Quotas are edited in Manage features.
form.section_identity_hint: Internal code, name, and visual elements (badge, color).
form.section_commercial_hint: Reference amounts for Orvae. SendSaaS does not invoice from here.
form.section_visibility_hint: Controls whether the plan appears in the catalog and can be provisioned.

fields.codigo_hint: Lowercase, digits, and underscore only. Must start with a letter. Cannot change later.
fields.descripcion_hint: Short text of what the plan includes.
fields.descripcion_placeholder: One OpenWA number, 2 users, and 500 messages per day…
fields.precio_anual_hint: Optional. SendSaaS does not charge from here.
fields.trial_days_hint: Free days when provisioning (0 = no trial).
fields.es_publico_hint: If off, the plan is hidden from public listings.
fields.activo_hint: If off, Orvae cannot provision it.

features_modal.title: Manage features
features_modal.description: OpenWA quotas, messages, and send window for this plan

descriptions.max_usuarios: Company people who can use the inbox.
descriptions.max_whatsapp_sessions: How many WhatsApp numbers can connect to OpenWA.
descriptions.max_outbound_per_day: Outbound messages allowed in one day. −1 = unlimited.
descriptions.max_outbound_per_month: Outbound messages allowed in one month. −1 = unlimited.
descriptions.max_contacts: Contacts that fit in the address book.
descriptions.max_campaigns: Campaigns that can be active at once.
descriptions.max_automations: Automations that can be active at once.
descriptions.send_window_start: From this time (HH:MM) the system may send mass messages.
descriptions.send_window_end: Until this time (HH:MM) messages go out. Outside the window, drip pauses.
descriptions.soporte_tipo: Help channel for the plan: docs, email, whatsapp, or whatsapp_prioritario.

delete.title: Delete plan
delete.description: You are about to delete the plan {{name}}. This cannot be undone.

bulk.delete_description_one: 1 plan will be removed from the catalog.
bulk.delete_description_other: {{count}} plans will be removed from the catalog.
bulk.delete_description: {{count}} plans will be removed from the catalog.

empty.no_records_description: Create the first plan to define OpenWA and message quotas.
empty.no_results_description: Adjust filters or search to see more plans.

toast.load_error: We could not load plans. Try again in a few seconds.
